title: Vanity #1 #2 Lot Pacific Comics 1984 Will Meugniot Complete Series Avalone
condition_description: Both copies bright with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Vanity #1 and #2 (1984), Pacific Comics - the complete two-issue series by Will Meugniot. Space-age heroine Vanity, from the Stone Age to the Space Age.

- #1: Will Meugniot cover. Back cover: Groo Special #1 ad by Sergio Aragones
- #2: dinosaur cover; Avalone back-up feature. Back cover: Pathways to Fantasy ad

$1.50 cover price each. Both bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
